title: The Real Reason Your Hands Wrinkle in Water
hook: Still think your skin just soaks up water?

narration.text: Your wrinkly fingers in the bath are not from water absorption.
It is actually your nervous system responding.
Tiny blood vessels constrict beneath the skin's surface.
This makes the outer skin layer shrink, creating wrinkles.
Scientists believe it helps you grip wet objects better.
It is like your body's built-in all-terrain tyres.
Next time, notice how much easier it is to pick up wet items. Like this if you found this surprising and subscribe for more body secrets.

description: Ever wondered why your fingers and toes get pruney in water? It is not just about soaking up moisture. Discover the surprising real reason behind this body phenomenon.
topic: Why your hands and feet get wrinkly in water. This is a special body response, not just absorption.
